verdict.rationale: Speakeasy publishes a working llms.txt (HTTP 200) and offers markdown versions of docs pages (.md suffix, confirmed via probe), plus agents.md with agent-oriented CLI instructions, directly enabling agents to consume agent-oriented docs. missing for 10: no independent third-party confirmation that agents actually parse/use these files effectively, and no evidence of a full sitewide llms-full.txt or comprehensive machine-readable doc index beyond spot-checked pages.
